items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Tuesday, 05 May 2026 at 10:25pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Nil.


##Synopsis##

High pressure in the mid-Atlantic, with shallow area of low pressure near Scotland, as weak frontal zones affect the British Isles.


##Wind##

East 4 or 5, veering East or Southeast later in the night or tomorrow morning and decreasing 3 or 4. Veering South or Southeast 3 or 4 tomorrow evening.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate, becoming slight later tonight or at first tomorrow.


##Weather##

Fair to start, then isolated rain soon, becoming confined to the west later.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

South or Southeast 3 or 4, increasing South 4 or 5 for a time.


##State of Sea##

Slight, becoming slight or moderate for a time.


##Weather##

Fair, then scattered showers for a time.


##Visibility##

Good, possibly moderate in showers.
